propositions: Rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project mappings (status, type, priority, link relations, transitions, parents) preventing per-project workflow variance without core edits.
Mapping constants are duplicated across value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py, creating maintenance burden and tight coupling.
A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam must layer built-in defaults, config-level defaults, and per-project overlays (deep-merged), with fail-closed validation at config load.
Unmapped rebar concepts must support four strategies: collapse (with round-trip-safe rebar-type: label), skip (type-granular exclusion), map to a target value, or drift with warning.
Non-allowed transitions require replay logic deriving the hop sequence from rebar's persisted per-ticket STATUS event log and re-attempting via existing single-hop primitives before drifting.
Non-representable parents must drift and leave echo-safe breadcrumb comments naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key.
